purpose: Select the pre-data run-to-seed-to-problem estimators, CRN-aware H3 effect definition, exact zero/tie inference, global multiplicity family and infrastructure-missingness policy, then authorize preparation of an additive statistical-analysis amendment and expected-red/static analysis-contract tests only. This candidate does not freeze or activate an amendment, implement analysis code, inspect results, execute an optimizer/evaluator or consume formal FFE.

decision_A_gap_acknowledgement.meaning: Acknowledge that the frozen structural plan does not yet define one analysis for all immutable run packages. This acknowledgement is not a performance or quality conclusion.

definition: H1: for each problem-algorithm-seed run, take the median of NMI at the four fixed checkpoints, with inactive/fallback checkpoint=0; the problem-algorithm endpoint is the median across the 30 run values.
H1 control effect: compute the same-seed run-level CVGR-minus-control contrast first, then take the problem-level median across available prespecified pairs.

H2: for each run, direction success proportion equals successes divided by all activated directed-difference events; zero activation gives run proportion=0; the problem-algorithm endpoint is the median of 30 equally weighted run proportions.
H2 control effect: compute same-seed run-level proportion contrasts first, then take the problem-level median.
Event-pooled H2 and alternative aggregation orders are secondary exploratory sensitivity analyses only and cannot rescue a failed primary branch.
decision_U_H1_H2_seed_aggregation.constraint: Any alternative must uniquely define run, seed, problem and contrast aggregation before formal result access.

definition: Primary problem-level A12 uses every retained CVGR-comparator outcome pair with feasible-first ordering and tie weight 0.5; direction is probability that CVGR is better.
The comparison kernel, constraint tolerance and algorithm-failure worst outcome are frozen before data.
Because the same 30 seeds are used across algorithms, report a prespecified aligned-seed superiority proportion and paired seed-difference summary as secondary CRN sensitivity.
Use a CRN-aware seed bootstrap or another separately specified method for within-problem uncertainty; do not use seed-level p values as primary inference.

alternatives.consequence: Replace A12 with the 30-pair common-random-number superiority probability and re-justify the 0.56 threshold in a versioned amendment.
Use only nonmatching-seed cross pairs, name the estimator explicitly and predeclare its uncertainty method.

definition: Remove exact zero problem-level differences from the signed-rank statistic but report their count.
Assign deterministic midranks to tied absolute nonzero differences.
Enumerate all sign assignments over the nonzero ranked differences to calculate the predeclared one-sided tail probability.
If every difference is zero, set p=1 and route to failure or inconclusive according to the frozen effect boundary.
Freeze artificial vectors that cover positive, negative, zero, tied and all-zero cases with hand-computable expected statistics and p values.
decision_Z_exact_rank_test.constraint: Do not delegate the statistical definition to an unfrozen library auto mode.

definition: Form one global H1 p value as the maximum of its two required comparator p values, conditional on both practical-effect thresholds being met.
Form one global H2 p value analogously from its two required comparator p values.
Form one global H3 p value as the maximum of its three required comparator p values, conditional on all three A12 thresholds being met.
Apply Holm correction across the three global H1, H2 and H3 hypotheses before selecting any supported mechanism route; H4 is a deterministic integrity gate outside this family.
A positive paper route requires adjusted H3 success plus at least one adjusted mechanism success and no mechanism failure; non-failure alone is not positive mechanism support.

alternatives.consequence: Require both mechanism hypotheses before testing H3 under a fixed-sequence gate; narrower and more conservative mechanism claim.
Retain all effect thresholds and all-problem reporting but downgrade formal statistical-confirmation language.

definition: After the one authorized same-seed recovery attempt, zero or one unresolved infrastructure failure per 30-run problem-algorithm cell is allowed for computation; two or more unresolved failures, i.e. at least 6.67 percent, make every affected confirmatory hypothesis inconclusive.

For one unresolved failure, remove the matched seed partner from that comparator-specific endpoint and use exactly 29 complete pairs; never replace it with a new seed and never overwrite the original or retry package.
If the failed cell is CVGR, the same seed is absent from all CVGR-versus-control comparisons for that problem.
Any algorithm-attributable failure is not missing: it receives frozen fail-closed H1/H2 values and the worst H3 outcome.
Every primary table reports attempted, completed, retried, algorithm-failed and infrastructure-missing counts.
decision_X_infrastructure_missingness.constraint: Any alternative must state an exact integer threshold and paired analysis action before formal execution.
